scripts.local-deploy: kubectl config use-context ${KUBE_CONTEXT:-k3s-local} && kubectl apply -f charts/web/templates/deployment.yaml -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default} && kubectl rollout status deployment/joey-agent -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default} --timeout=120s
scripts.teardown: kubectl config use-context ${KUBE_CONTEXT:-k3s-local} && kubectl delete -f charts/web/templates/deployment.yaml -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default}
